board.prompt: Create a focused visual style board for a Chinese xianxia game icon family. Show a tidy grid of twelve standalone icons with no labels and no text: mountain peak, ancient sect gate, sword seal, thunder mark, cloud, herb sprig, beast mask, skull sigil, star, void spiral, spirit stone, and mission scroll. The icons share one restrained visual language: muted teal lacquer, ivory parchment, aged gold linework, quiet ink-like painted texture, crisp silhouettes, slightly weathered but readable at 20 to 32 pixels. Each icon is centered in an equal square cell with generous spacing. No UI panels, no buttons, no characters, no scenery, no watermark.
